description: Representative full-scale 12 x 8 m shield section; NOT enclosing torus shield. Three display courses total 1.7 m sourced brick thickness, with narrow assembly seams and a deliberately removed upper corner exposing the lower courses.
coordinateConvention: +Y up, minimum model y=0. Orbital parts use display support/bounding datum, not terrain feet or operational gravity. Local Z is specimen tube/transport axis, local Y is hub spin/docking axis.

sourceFacts.fact: Shield is separate/unconnected to torus with approximately 1.5 m gap.
Shield is 1.7 m thick fused undifferentiated lunar soil bricks with mechanical fasteners.
